summary: Backend + frontend testing for STD-RFN-0001 Refinement Initiative. 9/10 pytest passed. Frontend fully functional: refinement page loads, 3 engines, 4 inheritance-matrix rows, benchmark ran and manufactured 5 KRs -> 30 products with Gold Standard=0 (honesty invariant OK), Learning tab shows 2 recommendations. One real regression bug found: /api/flow/registry only returns 3 hardcoded standards (missing STD-EIP-0002 and STD-RFN-0001).

minor.issue: Only returns the 3 hardcoded seed entries (QRU-CON-0001, QRU-CON-0002, STD-MFG-0001). Missing STD-EIP-0002 and STD-RFN-0001 even though both are inserted into db.constitutional_registry by their seed functions. Root cause: manufacturing_flow.constitutional_registry() iterates a hardcoded seed list of length 3 (backend/manufacturing_flow.py lines 248-262) instead of returning all rows from the collection.

action_items: Fix /api/flow/registry (manufacturing_flow.constitutional_registry): return all rows from db.constitutional_registry so STD-EIP-0002 and STD-RFN-0001 are exposed. Suggested fix: after building the hardcoded seed baseline, also union in any extra ids present in db.constitutional_registry that are not in the seed list, or simply return all stored rows sorted by created_at.
critical_code_review_comments: refinement_engine.run_benchmark: correctly enforces the honesty invariant — gold_standard_products=0 verified.
refinement_engine._verify: independent verification block correctly emits APPROVED_INTERNAL_PENDING_HUMAN_VERIFICATION for definitional topics (no false external certification).
refinement_engine.manufacture_product: correctly gates Gold on both preflight AND KR external verification.

manufacturing_flow.constitutional_registry: hardcoded seed list — needs to be data-driven so new standards added via other seed functions appear in /api/flow/registry (impacts Refinement Era claim: 'nothing retired').
refinement_engine.seed_refinement: writes to db.constitutional_registry via upsert (good), but the read path in /flow/registry ignores it.
seed_data_creation: Benchmark run inserted 5 additional KRs and 30 products (plus prior test-run artifacts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refinement Era iteration 53. All /api/refinement/* endpoints are working correctly and honesty invariant (no false external Gold) is preserved. The only remaining issue is /api/flow/registry which only exposes the original 3 constitutional standards; fix is trivial (return all stored constitutional_registry rows).
rca of the issue: In /app/backend/manufacturing_flow.py the constitutional_registry() function builds its output by iterating a hardcoded 3-item seed list and looking up each id in the DB. New standards (STD-EIP-0002 from enterprise_architecture.seed_eip, STD-RFN-0001 from refinement_engine.seed_refinement) are upserted into db.constitutional_registry but never returned because their ids are not in the hardcoded seed. Reproduction: GET /api/flow/registry -> registry has 3 entries. Mitigation: change constitutional_registry() to `stored = [d async for d in db.constitutional_registry.find({}, {'_id': 0})]` and return all rows (or union with the baseline seed).
